Place a clearly visible strip of background above her entire hairstyle, and keep her complete crown, face, and both eyes clearly readable. The second lighting direction has authority over every actual source shape, direction, and illumination color. Keep the face and requested visible eyes readable, and make each source named by that direction visibly distinct. Give its named reflected light or fill a separate readable role. Treat these as material, set, pigment, and graphic properties; the second lighting direction alone supplies every actual source and illumination color. The image uses crisp controlled shadows with clean shapes and readable reflected light and neutral daylight balance with accurate skin undertones and quiet fabric color. Resolve both directions on the same adult subject. Give every named visual cue an obvious, concrete location on the face, clothing, silhouette, lighting, or environment. Preserve the selected medium and keep the face, eyes, visible hands, joints, garment construction, and spatial relationships coherent. Finish the single scene cleanly with text-free, logo-free, watermark-free imagery. Its named reflected light or fill remains visibly separate from the key. The first style contributes shape, material palette, surface, atmosphere, and edge treatment.
